mapper.select: SELECT chapter_id, title, description, course_id, created_at, updated_at FROM edu.chapters WHERE course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY chapter_id
INSERT INTO edu.chapters (course_id, title, description, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{courseId}, #{title}, #{description}, NOW(), NOW()) RETURNING chapter_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu.chapter_learning_outcomes (chapter_id, learning_outcome_id) VALUES (#{chapterId}, #{learningOutcomeId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO edu.exam_matrix_row_learning_outcomes (exam_matrix_row_id, learning_outcome_id, is_selected) SELECT matrix_row.id, #{learningOutcomeId}, FALSE FROM edu.exam_matrix_rows matrix_row JOIN edu.chapter_learning_outcomes chapter_outcome ON chapter_outcome.chapter_id = matrix_row.chapter_id AND chapter_outcome.learning_outcome_id = #{learningOutcomeId} WHERE matrix_row.chapter_id = #{chapterId} ON CONFLICT (exam_matrix_row_id, learning_outcome_id) DO NOTHING
